d: Short, messy charcoal-black hair with voluminous curls frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, calm dark brown eyes. The slender build is dressed in a muted olive-green safari jacket over a light beige button-up, paired with high-waisted light grey trousers cuffed at the ankles and dark grey loafers. A tattered brown scarf is draped over the shoulders, and a brown leather utility belt holds a small camera. Signature accessories include a large vintage silver and black camera held to the face, a second camera hanging from the hip, and a large brown leather equipment case slung across the body.
